title: What the Python SDK's ZTW modules cover beyond the Go SDK, and where they stop

prose.text: The Python SDK's ZTW modules and their endpoints are generated (`node scripts/kb.mjs surface ztw`, the `sdk_python` entries). This subject records the two places where what they send or cover matters for an answer.

prose.label: Destination workload groups.
prose.text: {{dest-workload-groups-added-1-9-13}} {{dest-workload-groups-wire-key}} Only the Python SDK sends the field: the API contract and the Go SDK do not carry it [[cloud-connector.api.rules-wire:workload-groups]], and whether the API accepts it is open in [[cloud-connector.api.rules-wire]]. The console criterion it maps to, and its Local-only scope, are in [[zia.workload-groups.rule-scoping]].

prose.label: Workload groups.
prose.text: {{workload-groups-list-only}} Neither SDK nor the ZTC provider writes workload groups: [[cloud-connector.terraform.forwarding-rules]].

prose.label: Discovery service.
prose.text: {{discovery-path-param-names}} Which ID the API actually takes there is open in [[cloud-connector.workload-discovery.permission-status]].

checks.do: Read back a forwarding rule written with dest_workload_groups_ids and confirm destWorkloadGroups was stored, since the API contract does not list it.

dest-workload-groups-added-1-9-13.statement: Release 1.9.13 of the Python SDK added a `dest_workload_groups_ids` attribute to the ZTW forwarding rules module.

quotes: Added new attribute `dest_workload_groups_ids` to ZTW `forwarding_rules` resource

dest-workload-groups-wire-key.statement: `add_rule` and `update_rule` pass their keyword arguments through `transform_common_id_fields` with the shared `reformat_params` table, which maps `dest_workload_groups_ids` to the wire key `destWorkloadGroups`.

workload-groups-list-only.statement: The Python ZTW workload groups module has one API method, `list_groups`, a GET on the workload groups path; it cannot create, update or delete them.
workload-groups-list-only.conditions: Absence: zscaler/ztw/workload_groups.py at the pin defines two methods, __init__ and list_groups; no create, update or delete method exists in the module.

discovery-path-param-names.statement: Both SDKs call the discovery-permissions PUT, but name its path parameter differently: the Python method takes `account_group_id`, the Go function `awsAccountID`.
